headline: **MLB Daily Recap: Braves, Padres, and Pirates Secure Wins**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The San Diego Padres also secured a win, taking down the Washington Nationals 7-5 behind Curtis Mead's 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with the Chicago White Sox placing Munetaka Murakami on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Jordan Leasure was transferred from the 15-day to the 60-day injured list with a right flexor strain. The Los Angeles Dodgers also made several moves, transferring Blake Snell to the 60-day injured list with left elbow loose bodies and placing Teoscar Hernández on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain.

The Detroit Tigers made a roster move ahead of the deadline, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Nationals 7-5**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 7-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-5 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gregory Soto earning the win. Trevor Larnach led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Samuel Basallo leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Murakami Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox first baseman Munetaka Murakami has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Tigers Make Roster Move Ahead of Deadline**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
